Package es.uma.eda.divideandconquer.algebra.diophantine.approximation

Classes for diophantine approximation of real (floating-point) numbers using divide and conquer
Author:
ccottap
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    BinarySearchDiophantineApproximator
    Generic procedure for conducting binary search to find the rational approximation of a floating-point number.
    MediantApproximation
    Approximates a real number to an irreducible rational fraction using the mediant approximation - see: Farey sequence, Stern-Brocot tree
    TestBinarySearchApproximation
    Tests the binary search approximation algorithm
